total.description: Total issue/return transactions matching the filters (all pages); not a count of work orders or items.

total_pages.description: Number of pages for this query.

has_more.description: True if there are more pages after this one.

date_field.description: Transaction date the range applied to: actualdate (default) or transdate.

date_from.description: Start date applied (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive); null if no date filter.

date_to.description: End date applied (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive); null if no date filter.

filters.description: Normalized filters applied, by parameter name.

items.description: Transactions in this page, ordered chronologically by date_field. Only the requested fields are present; quantity is negative for issues and positive for returns, linecost the opposite; refwo is the work order; dates are yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss in server time.

error.description: Present only when the request is invalid. No other field is returned.
